chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather Al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Twenty-one red raisins, every day upon the saliva (empty stomach), dispel all diseases except the disease of death.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended remedy for dispelling diseases according to Imam Ali in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in Al-Kafi’s chapter on raisins, highlights the Prophetic tradition of using natural remedies for health preservation, specifically linking the consumption of twenty-one red raisains on an empty stomach to the prevention of all diseases except death. In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often interpreted not merely as a literal prescription but as a symbolic reference to the completeness of divine mercy and the holistic approach to well-being (Tibb al-Nabawi) that integrates physical health with spiritual reliance on God.
